statement: Five-node startup keeps one versioned, incarnation-bound formation-release handoff authority from the first whole-plane priority-spread-satisfied observation until every captured JOINING cohort member has published a current READY lease, so non-monotone spread-gap reopening cannot strand joiners and the unchanged 60-second GCP certification plus 120-second internal barrier both close without weakening safety. Third seal (v3): v1 and v2 are frozen superseded history, each carrying an unresolvable new-quest-only attempt-integrity violation from operator-ordering (attempt recorded before measuring evidence). The exact candidate is preserved at solve/changes/formation-release-handoff-closure-v2/attempt-1.diff (sha256 1a5d29909a903312aa916808038d7340e94165d0ad3e21d142f06fb9c16afd61). This v3 follows begin → real GCP evidence → record exact diff.

constraints.statement: Treat the failure as systemic until the producer, startup-authority, rebalancer cure, join barrier, stable-window, READY-lease publication, harness, recovery, and terminal-consumer cone plus its history are explicit; preserve a single owner per subsystem and interaction.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Add exactly one subordinate formation-release handoff-closure owner under the existing startup-authority/recovery interaction; rebalancer, join readiness, publication, and the harness contribute evidence or consume its decision but never mint parallel release authority.

The closure proof is bound to publication/topology epoch and node boot incarnation, captures the JOINING cohort at the first globally satisfied priority-spread observation, and remains valid only until every member publishes a current READY lease; disconnect, incarnation change, substantive safety failure, or incompatible topology epoch revokes or rotates it fail-closed.
The join barrier and bootstrap readiness consume the same whole-plane authority answer; target-specific node reads cannot disagree with the seed/global release owner for one generation.
The TLC bug/fixed pair permits spread gaps to reopen and proves stable-window plus READY-publication completion under event cadence; no proof may assume monotone openGaps arithmetic.

Preserve the operator-owned 60-second five-node GCP certification window, the 120-second internal formation barrier, event-loop budgets, CL-036/remove safety, exact retry limits, and all existing admission floors; do not solve this with sleeps, timeout widening, retries, or readiness weakening.

Closure requires fresh exact-source GCP evidence with N>=2 fixed and N>=2 exact aggregate revert runs: fixed must show at least two barrier-held joiners, a real spread-ready then spread-reopened cadence, one retained release generation, every cohort member READY inside 60 seconds, and zero formation timeout; reverted outcomes are recorded fail-honestly.
Run only narrow focused deterministic checks locally while monitoring CPU and SSD temperature; run broad, long-running, large, model, and live-cluster validation in GCP.
